questions.q: He took / leave of / four days
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'Leave' for a period takes 'for': 'took leave for four days' (or 'four days' leave').
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: Children/ should always / listen the advice of their elders / and well wishers.
options: listen the advice of their elders
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'Listen' takes 'to' before its object: 'listen to the advice'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: He will not / listen / what you say.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'Listen to what you say': 'listen' needs 'to'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: Nobody denies / that my ideas / are different than yours.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'Different' takes 'from', not 'than': 'different from yours'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: It was I who was responsible of / making all the arrangements for the / successful completion of his studies.
options: It was I who was responsible of
making all the arrangements for the

questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: She was in the courtyard / when the burglars / entered into her house.

questions.explanation: 'Enter' is transitive: 'entered her house' needs no 'into'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: Our teacher / emphasised on / the use of correct grammar.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'Emphasise' is transitive and takes no 'on': 'emphasised the use'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: On the time / of the opening ceremony of the theatre / a large crowd had assembled
options: of the opening ceremony of the theatre

questions.explanation: The fixed phrase is 'at the time of'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: While they were returning / from school, / a stalker attacked on them with a knife.
options: a stalker attacked on them with a knife.

questions.explanation: 'Attack' is transitive: 'attacked them', without 'on'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: The decline of his moral values / has caused a lot / of pain to his parents

questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: Without thinking / for a moment he / entrusted me in all the responsibilities.

questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: Sudha fell in / the well and nobody / tried to save him.

questions.q: I / prefer coffee / than tea

questions.explanation: 'Run over' (not 'run out') means knocked down by a vehicle.

questions.q: Mr. Bacon has / great affection to / his family.

questions.q: Rekha has a great / enmity for her / brother's friend.

questions.q: He threw the bucket / into the river / and returned home without any water.

questions.q: There appears / to be very little / understanding among the two brothers

questions.q: She was / angry on me because I / had not invited her to party.

questions.q: He got a prestigious job though / he was not worthy / for it.

questions.q: My father / deals / with garments

questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: I cannot / deal from / those unruly students

questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.
